## Today

Segment/station names are not a domain value: `Station` (core-domain
`Station.kt`) is a bare enum (`SKI_ERG`, `SLED_PUSH`, `SLED_PULL`,
`BURPEE_BROAD_JUMP`, `ROW`, `FARMERS_CARRY`, `SANDBAG_LUNGES`,
`WALL_BALLS`) and `SegmentBlueprint` (core-domain) only maps an index
to a `SegmentType`/`Station`, never to a string. Every displayed name
already goes through the §10.4 resource catalogue: `PhoneStringResources
.segmentName(index)` and `WatchStringResources.segmentName(index)`
(`app-phone`/`app-wear`, `ui/text/*StringResources.kt`) each resolve
"Run n" / the station's own `segment_name_station_*` resource / one of
the 8 flat `segment_name_roxzone_out_*` resources / the fixed
`segment_name_final` ("Wall Balls") — every one of them a key in
`strings.xml` (e.g. `segment_name_station_ski_erg` = "SkiErg",
`segment_name_roxzone_out_farmers_carry` = "Roxzone → Farmers Carry"),
never a literal in code. `RaceDetailViewModel.cycles` (row `name`)
calls `PhoneStringResources.segmentName`; `MainRacePageViewModel`
(`stationLabel`, `RaceCenterBlock.NextStep`) calls
`WatchStringResources.segmentName` for the station and the Roxzone
destination on the main race page. `HyresultResultParser`'s own
`Station -> "SkiErg"` mapping (core-domain) is a separate, private
label set used only to parse a pasted result's row text against the
30-position cycle, never rendered.
